Gielen, D.J. (1997). Building Materials and CO2: Western European Emission Reduction Strategies. Report ECN-C--97-065, Netherlands Energy Research Foundation ECN, Petten, October 1997. No DOI printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (equal to PDF pages). This is a building-sector materials-flow and substitution study (background for Western European MARKAL); it holds almost no process-technology energy data. Main file kept small: geopolymeric cement (0.5 t CO2/t clinker saving, +10-20 ECU/t, 20-40 ECU/t CO2), slag cement (sector potential and abatement cost), and wood waste recycling by UF-resin hydrolysis (1 GJ/t steam, 100-230 ECU/t product). Measures: Table 5.14 options (Mt CO2/yr, ECU/t CO2, status). Other-values: Table 3.1 specific CO2 by material, Table 10.4, Table 7.1, clinker ratio, Table 9.8 building costs. Not loaded: building-level material requirements (Ch. 6), heating demand and thermal mass (Ch. 8, App. 1), cost tables 9.1-9.7, LCA chapter. No data for the candidate archetypes kiln_ceramic-electric or dryer_kiln-waste-heat (bricks appear only as material quantities and 0.15 t CO2/t). No price year printed for ECU values.
